blocks.text: E-commerce platforms and online marketplaces allow businesses to sell products and services over the internet. They connect sellers with customers without the need for a physical store. These platforms make buying and selling easier, faster, and more accessible to a wider audience. Examples include websites and apps where users can browse products, compare prices, and place orders online. They play an important role in supporting digital entrepreneurship by reducing costs and expanding market reach.
